title_en: Psychology Made Simple (11/20): The Echo Chamber in Your Phone
note_en: 对那些…相反意见，他却视而不见 "the opposite view he simply turns a blind eye to" uses the chengyu (four-character idiom) 视而不见, literally "look but not see." Notice the frame 对 + object + 视而不见: the thing being ignored is moved to the front with 对, because the idiom itself can't take an object after it. English has a matching image, "turn a blind eye to."
